orig_text:
IALocator-Options:  Options associated with this SRv6 Locator.  A
         variable-length field (determined by subtracting the length of
         SRv6-Locator from Option-Len minus 12).  The status code
         NoSRv6LocatorAvail indicates the server has no locators available
         to assign to the IA_SRV6_LOCATOR(s).
correct_text:
IALocator-Options:  Options associated with this SRv6 Locator.  A
         variable-length field (determined by subtracting the length of
         SRv6-Locator from Option-Len minus 16).  The status code
         NoSRv6LocatorAvail indicates the server has no locators available
         to assign to the IA_SRV6_LOCATOR(s).
notes:
Correct "12" to "16".

Section 4.2 defines: "Option-Len: 16 + the length of SRv6-Locator + the length of the IALocator-Options field in octets."

Therefore the length of IALocator-Options is  Option-Len − 16 − length(SRv6-Locator) , i.e. "Option-Len minus 16," not "Option-Len minus 12."

The erroneous "12" may have been carried over from the IA_SRV6_LOCATOR option in Section 4.1, whose fixed portion (IAID + T1 + T2 = 12 octets) is correctly "Option-Len minus 12."

orig_text:
A client uses Request, Renew, Rebind, Release, and Decline messages
during the normal lifecycle of SRv6 Locator assignment.
correct_text:
A client uses Request, Renew, Rebind, and Release messages during
the normal lifecycle of SRv6 Locator assignment.
notes: Section 5.2 lists the Decline message as part of the SRv6 Locator assignment lifecycle, but the Decline message is not supported elsewhere in the document. "Decline" applies to assigned addresses and is not used for delegated prefixes, so it does not apply here.
